title: Research media admission bounds retained downloads until storage completes
steps: Run media admission tests with twelve transfers across two job groups; hold object storage, enqueue an exclusive video before another image, and reject each pipeline phase.
Run two real executor instances for separate place research jobs against PostgreSQL, hold their object stores, and observe fetched buffer count before releasing storage.
expect: Only five image callbacks enter while object storage remains pending.
A queued video enters after current images finish storage and before any later image.
Fetch, decoder and storage rejection all release image and exclusive video permits.
Two real executor instances fetch only five pictures until pending stores release, then both jobs finish with ten downloads.
fence: one process-wide FIFO weighted permit held from before fetch through completed media storage

cmd: --test-name-pattern=research jobs share|a queued video|fetch, decoder|two executor instances admit
tests: research jobs share five media slots held from fetch through completed object storage
a queued video waits for all image stores and prevents later images from overtaking it
fetch, decoder and object storage rejections release image and exclusive video permits
two executor instances admit only five downloaded pictures until real media storage completes
